comment: A checking row's own polarity, read back through the same provenance path as its source_ref (select.py._provenance), decides whether a checking_outcome value is a genuine result or a negated checking action restated as a placeholder value (CONTRACT.md C5: 'checking_outcome: denied from a negated [checking action]'). select.py looks up (intent, case, polarity_key) here for an override; a missing key (notably polarity_true) means pass the literal fact value through unchanged. select.py never branches on the literal outcome string itself. polarity_mixed means the provenance disagreed with itself across merged hops and is reported as its own case rather than guessed.
